Corpora.Name: architecture
Corpora.Description: Search a curated corpus of software architecture books (Software Architecture - The Hard Parts, Microservices Patterns, DDD Distilled, Software Architecture Patterns, Building Evolutionary Architectures, Building Event-Driven Microservices, Building an Event-Driven Data Mesh, Monolith to Microservices) for established architecture concepts, patterns, trade-offs, DDD terminology, microservices design, evolutionary architecture, and event-driven patterns. Prefer over WebSearch for any established architectural concept. Use WebSearch for recent developments, specific products, or news.

Corpora.Name: system-design
Corpora.Description: Search a curated corpus of system design books (System Design - ByteByteGo, System Design Interview by Alex Xu) for scalable system design questions: sharding, replication, queueing, caching, load balancing, consistent hashing, leader election, capacity estimation, and worked design examples (URL shortener, chat system, news feed, etc.). Prefer over WebSearch for system-design-interview-style questions and scalability fundamentals. Use ArchitectureCorpus for higher-level architectural patterns and DDD; use WebSearch for recent products and news.
